3661-5006-8095-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Shield Sphere is starting in your graveyard.
3661-5006-8095-8170.description:
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Shield Sphere spell. Then, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Shield Sphere, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

569-2226-5921.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
569-2226-5921.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Fractured Realm.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Mist Raven by paying its mana cost.
When Mist Raven enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-2443-2841-4677.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Evolving Wilds.
1479-2443-2841-4677.description:
Fetch a land using Evolving Wilds.
When the fetched land enters, Zendikar's Roil and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

553-4586-6108.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using High Fae Trickster.
In response, cast Endless Detour by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

3129-4682-5140-7824.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
3129-4682-5140-7824.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Primal Vigor and Bard.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
3129-4682-5140-7824.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

475-2919-5641-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-2919-5641-7810.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

5686-6258--5.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat

2633-4499-7494.description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying no more than {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
When you cast that spell, Urbarask triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and adding {R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.

2103-4863-5144.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Revolutionist and exiling Ephemerate.
When Revolutionist enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Revolutionist.
When Revolutionist enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3967-4871-5220-5243.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
3967-4871-5220-5243.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1409-2397-6463.description:
Activate Meticulous Artisan by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Meticulous Artisan enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Meticulous Artisan.
Resolve both Meticulous Artisan triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

2085-4927-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kelpie Guide.
Activate one of the Kelpie Guide tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kelpie Guide token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-5226-5671.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5226-5671.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size, one of which must be a land card.
250-779-1479-5226-5671.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, The Necrobloom and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Lithatog ability
Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard a land and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return a land from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

339-677-2034-5223.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3305-3817-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing Body Launderer to connive.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

518-2655-6191.notablePrerequisites:
Bloodthirsty Conqueror has indestructible.
You control another indestructible creature.
You have a way to deal damage to Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
518-2655-6191.description:
Cast Arcbond by paying {2}{R}, targeting Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
Holding priority, cast Fury Storm by paying its mana cost, copying Arcbond, with the copy targeting another indestructible creature you control.
Resolve both Arcbonds.
Deal damage to Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
Arbond triggers, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent dealt damage, and Arcbond triggers due to the other indestructible creature being dealt damage.
Resolve all Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Arcbond trigger, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent dealt damage, and Arcbond triggers due to Bloodthirsty Conqueror being dealt damage.
Resolve all Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Arcbond trigger, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Repeat form step 6.

222-527-3499-5231.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{G}{G}.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2506-2743-3657.description:
Cast Biovisionary by paying {1}{G}{U}.
When Biovisionary enters the battlefield, Molten Echoes triggers, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning the nontoken Biovisionary from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time, and then repeat steps 1 and 2 one additional time.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

394-856-3698-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar, Grinding Station and Desecrated Tomb trigger.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Repeat.

141-5686-6476.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus enough mana and/or cards in your graveyard to cast Afterlife from the Loam
141-5686-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Afterlife from the Loam.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Afterlife from the Loam, targeting Naru Meha and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Afterlife from the Loam, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

997-5394-6291.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-3062-3263.easyPrerequisites: Jetfire has no +1/+1 counters on it.
114-3062-3263.description:
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

2351-4639-6241.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Telethopter by tapping a blue creature you control except Unctus.
The creature triggers, causing you to loot.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Telethopter ability.
Repeat.

5-708-2500-4050.description:
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Myth Unbound until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Oviya, adding {G}.
Choose to return Oviya to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Mirage Mirror trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Cast Oviya from the command zone by paying {G}.
Repeat from step 2.

802-864-1170-1414-1741.notablePrerequisites: You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
802-864-1170-1414-1741.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Snap, returning Cloud of Faeries from the battlefield to your hand, and untapping two lands you control.
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Snap from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast Cloud of Faeries by paying {1}{U}.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping two lands you control.
Repeat.
You may instead bounce any creature you don't control to its owner's hand instead of bouncing the generic creature, as long as your opponents control creatures.

1558-5261-5443.notablePrerequisites:
Officious Interrogation exiled by Isochron Scepter.
A player controls at least five creatures.
1558-5261-5443.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Officious Interrogation without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Officious Interrogation, creating at least five Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Clues, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

803-1641-2034-4720.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Promised Kannushi, adding {C}{C}.
When Promised Kannushi dies, its soulshift ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {G}.
Cast Promised Kannushi by paying {G}.
Repeat.

283-1921-2585-4404.notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Tawnos.
Tawnos does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two artifact tokens.
283-1921-2585-4404.description:
Activate Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Tawnos' second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it, sacrificing two artifact tokens and exiling Corridor Monitor from your graveyard.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Tawnos' ability.
Resolve the copy of Tawnos' ability, creating a token copy of Corridor Monitor.
The Corridor Monitor token enters the battlefield, untapping Tawnos.
Resolve the second Tawnos ability, creating a token copy of Corridor Monitor.
The Corridor Monitor token enters the battlefield, untapping Grim Monolith.
Activate Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Tawnos' first ability by paying {2} and tapping it.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Tawnos' ability.
Resolve the copy of Tawnos' ability, creating a token copy of Corridor Monitor and causing you to mill two cards.
The Corridor Monitor token enters the battlefield, untapping Tawnos.
Resolve the second Tawnos ability, creating a token copy of Corridor Monitor and causing you to mill two cards.
The Corridor Monitor token enters the battlefield, untapping Grim Monolith.
Repeat from step 8.

1283-2397-2493-4615-4739.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two other creatures.
1283-2397-2493-4615-4739.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Battle Hymn by paying {2}, adding {1} for each creature you control.
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying {3}, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer.
The Archaeomancer token enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, returning Battle Hymn and Quasiduplicate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may return any other instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard in place of Battle Hymn.

1167-1329.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1167-1329.description:
Activate Mindslaver by paying {4}, tapping and sacrificing it, gaining control of target player's next turn.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Mindslaver from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Mindslaver from your graveyard by paying {6}.
Pass the turn.
End the controlled opponent turn.
Repeat.
